name: Point-based Rendering with Ray Bending
aliases: Controllable Human Motion Synthesis via Point Radiance Fields
Point-based Radiance Field Deformation with Ray-Bending
definition: A rendering method for deformed scenes using a neural point cloud (NPC) in canonical space. It predicts density and radiance by querying the pre-trained PointNeRF model, but transforms the deformed view direction to canonical space via ray bending to ensure consistent view-dependent rendering.
